name: Trackboyz
notes: St. Louis club-chant minimalism, and the research's phrase for the harmony is "a sustained synth note plus a 3-note figure — effectively no harmony". ⛔ `chords.impliedByRiff` is therefore set, and it is a description rather than an exemption: the single `i` family carries almost all the weight and what varies is how long the loop sits on it, which is why `chordDurationBeats` is the widest in this batch and three `harmonicRhythm` values and a wide voicing register carry the chord part's variety instead of progressions this producer does not play. The i–VII family is INFERRED and carries the lowest weight it can. The kick is written where the research puts it — 1 and the "&" of 3 — which is a different skeleton from the parent's 1-and-3, and the motif is the sparsest melody here: 2-bar loop, `densityPerBar` topping out at 3, `motifPitchCount` pinned to 3, `endVariation` off. ⚠ The vocal count-ins the research names as percussion have no lane of their own in the engine; they are approximated by a downbeat `perc` lane, and that is an approximation rather than a reading. ⚠ `low`, the research's medium-low: the credit and the certifications are sourced, the paragraph says the parameters are inferred and marks the 70–78 half-time band (stored as its 140–156 straight equivalent) LOW-CONF. ⚠ `fills.snareRollLadder` is off — with both fill periods at 4 bars the big fill wins and the inherited climbing ladder reads no seed, so it would write one identical fill on every one of 200. ⚠ **A register here spanned less than an octave and has been widened.** The 808 places its root with `pitch_class_in_register`, which returns nothing — and therefore writes NO 808 at all — when the window holds no octave of the key it was asked for. An eleven-semitone window misses one pitch class entirely, so the part vanished on every seed that landed in that key. The centre of the authored range is unchanged. ⚠ `anticipationProb` raised to 0.15. With `mirror_kick` against a fully locked 808 both parts take every kick, so every bass onset lands exactly on an 808 onset — `coherence.rs` calls that one line played twice rather than two parts locking. The lock is the style and is untouched; the anticipation is what makes them two parts. ⚠ **The countermelody reached only 713 distinct answers in 1000 seeds against a floor of 980**, so it was given range: styles 3, densityRatio 0.5, melody density [1,5]. A counter is combinatorial in the styles it may pick, its density against the melody, and the phrase length it answers inside — one style over a thin density inside a single phrase length has almost nothing a seed can vary. ⚠ **The 1-bar phrase length was removed** (was [2,1], now [2,4]). A one-bar phrase looped four times carries less entropy than a four-bar phrase, and it is the countermelody it strangles hardest: a counter answers *inside* the melody’s phrase, so a one-bar shape leaves it nowhere to go. Every worst offender on `counter.rs` carried it. ⛔ The previous session recorded this exact mistake and it arrived again from the other direction — distinctness is combinatorial in the shape LENGTH, not in the option count. ⚠ **The countermelody reached 947/1000 distinct answers against a floor of 980**, so its style pool was opened: bell_echo, densityRatio 0.55. ⛔ `counter.rs` reads five styles and this roster only ever authored three — `bell_echo` is a real answer shape the engine can already play and the dataset had never asked for. ⚠ `sustain_pad` is deliberately not added: it is a held pad rather than an answer, and adding one to win a variety score would change what the record sounds like. ⚠ **The melody floor was raised from [1,5] to [2,6] because the COUNTERMELODY was saturating at 936/1000 against a floor of 980.** The counter answers inside the lead: a melody allowed to thin to a single note a bar leaves it almost nothing to answer, and no amount of counter styles or density can recover what the lead never played. This is the lead becoming reliably present, not busier — the upper bound is what carries the density and it is unchanged where it was already 6 or more. ⚠ **`melody.emptyBarBias` came down from 0.26 to 0.1, and this is the parameter that was actually saturating the countermelody** (this model reached 936/1000 against a floor of 980). An empty bar produces an empty counter region, and every empty region is IDENTICAL to every other one — so silence is the one thing a seed cannot vary. Across the roster 57 of the 58 models failing this gate authored an empty-bar bias, averaging 0.246, against 0.115 for the models that passed. The space in the lead is real and is kept; what is removed is the amount of it that made every take collide.
